requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root to start the full stack.
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint to verify real-world behavior and observability.

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml for full stack
slices.jtbd: When implementing system containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose configuration, so that the full stack can be started with a single command and observability can be verified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When a developer runs docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the running stack, When the health-check endpoint is queried, Then it returns a success response.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local environment setup time from >10 mins to <1 min

requirements: R1: Implement UI actions to update existing epidemiological materials.
R2: Implement UI actions to delete existing epidemiological materials.

slices.title: Add update and delete actions to material UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management UI for this epic, I want to add update and delete functionality, so that the knowledge base accurately reflects the most current protocols.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user chooses to edit it in the UI, Then the frontend invokes the corresponding PUT endpoint.
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user chooses to delete it in the UI, Then the frontend invokes the corresponding DELETE endpoint.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Content management bottleneck in knowledge base
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce material update cycle time from >10 mins to <1 min

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents from unmeasured to 0
requirements: R1: Implement an authentication mechanism to identify users.
R2: Block unauthenticated users from accessing the catalog or creating materials, prompting them to log in.

slices.title: Enforce authentication for catalog access
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to enforce authentication checks, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog, Then they are blocked.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to create a material, Then they are prompted to log in.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized endpoint access from unmeasured to 0
